before_block_e1: cells with fewer than 10 unweighted respondents are suppressed (all estimates and counts null); registration rates with fewer than 10 valid answers are suppressed; estimates whose unweighted numerator is below 10 are kept and flagged low_precision with a 95% CI (reconstructed design)
after_block_e1: cells (region, zone and national) with fewer than 10 unweighted respondents are suppressed (all estimates and counts null); registration rates with fewer than 10 valid answers are suppressed; estimates whose unweighted numerator is below 10 are kept and flagged low_precision with a 95% CI (reconstructed design)

before_block_e1: Vectorised agent-based simulation. 500,000 synthetic agents, 10 years. Age, mobile money, urban residence and the starting TIN status are a weighted resample of real FinScope Tanzania 2023 respondents' attributes (aggregate cells, data/processed/agent_cells.json) with the real-data targeting model's predicted propensities; income, trust and morale are simulated. Compliance probability = f(trust, morale, income, MM). Interventions applied annually. Random seed: 42 for reproducibility.
after_block_e1: Vectorised agent-based simulation. 500,000 synthetic agents, 10 years. Age, mobile money, urban residence and the starting TIN status are a weighted resample of real FinScope Tanzania 2023 respondents' attributes (aggregate cells, data/processed/agent_cells.json) with the real-data targeting model's predicted propensities; income (ILFS 2024 earnings by age band) and trust and morale (Afrobarometer Round 8 by age band and urban/rural) are drawn from aggregate survey cell distributions. Compliance probability = f(trust, morale, income, MM). Interventions applied annually. Random seed: 42 for reproducibility.

before_block_e1: Standalone simulation, separate from run_agent_based_simulation -- shares no mutable state with it. Same population-generation approach (weighted resample of real FinScope respondents' age, mobile money, urban residence and predicted TIN propensity, aggregate cells; simulated income/trust/morale; random seed 42) plus two new per-agent dimensions: years_registered (increments while compliant) and a persistent filing-reliability trait correlated with trust and morale, redrawn with year-to-year noise rather than from scratch. Tier thresholds match exactly what the Enterprise-stage dashboard already displays.
after_block_e1: Standalone simulation, separate from run_agent_based_simulation -- shares no mutable state with it. Same population-generation approach (weighted resample of real FinScope respondents' age, mobile money, urban residence and predicted TIN propensity, aggregate cells; income, trust and morale from ILFS / Afrobarometer aggregate cell distributions; random seed 42) plus two new per-agent dimensions: years_registered (increments while compliant) and a persistent filing-reliability trait correlated with trust and morale, redrawn with year-to-year noise rather than from scratch. Tier thresholds match exactly what the Enterprise-stage dashboard already displays.

before_block_e1: the model is fitted on all adults; for ages 16-24 its mean prediction is above the observed rate, so predicted counts for Entry are upper bounds
after_block_e1: levels are recalibrated within the Entry band (intercept shift on the logit scale), so the mean prediction equals the observed rate; the ranking, and therefore the multiplier, is essentially unchanged
